title: Seizure false alarms and montage confounding
disposition_reason: The selected event-campaign-v1 source route now joins participant-owned held-person event intervals to the unchanged complete-cohort event scorer after all 686 records and 23 biological-person contexts are frozen. Programme and typed-viewer interfaces are source-available. Authentic complete preparation, independent runtime custody, participant and renderer services, genuine reference streams and a qualified campaign remain undelivered. Historical answer-bearing table reconstruction remains target-mismatch calibration evidence in the exact archived pre-adoption contract; its status is not retrospectively promoted.

scientific_target.question: Does a frozen EEG detector improve complete held-person seizure detection over a matched no-EEG method, and does the paired improvement survive montage-stratified analysis?
scientific_target.known_answer: Held-person differences in event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per observed day for frozen EEG, matched no-EEG, montage-only and fixed signal-reference streams; null or inconclusive contrasts are valid answers.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Operator-held CHB-MIT annotations and independently frozen full-record candidate/reference event streams. The selected source withholds held-person targets until the complete candidate freeze, reference admission and protected scorer callback. The historical analyst packet instead exposes annotations and prediction intervals for deterministic reconstruction; it is retained only as calibration evidence.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete 686-record CHB-MIT comparison panel, with localized false alarms nested in records and people.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 23 biological people, with chb01/chb21 merged; montage strata can have only one person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional association of permitted EEG use and event-detection quality within the public CHB-MIT development cohort. A candidate-specific matched ablation requires independently authenticated matching of its learning, training, tuning, metadata, tools, resource and signal-access conditions. Fixed-reference contrasts alone do not identify the neural contribution of an arbitrary participant.
exclusions: Neural understanding inferred from arithmetic reconstruction error
Artifact-type or causal attribution from unlabelled false-alarm windows
Independent replication inferred from montage rows or analyst replications
Treating a programme trained on other people versus a zero-shot viewer as an isolated effect of computational access
Clinical validity, general native neural understanding, statistical superiority or SOTA inferred from source availability or signed contrast alone

inputs: The selected frozen_program conditions deliver authenticated calibrated EEG windows through opaque record/signal handles, with training explicitly other22 or none. Other22 permits only the exact remaining 22 biological people for that held-person context before state freeze; none permits no training annotations.

The selected typed_viewer condition is visual-zero-shot: bounded rendered PNG observations from a separately qualified external renderer, with operator-preselected positive finite fixed display gain, explicit geometry and no training annotations. Its restricted unfiltered fixed display is not a claim of parity with a clinical EEG viewer.
All conditions use the same unlabelled recording/support identities and permitted montage information, with a separately frozen method, information, tuning and resource contract.
Historical reconstruction calibration alone uses released annotation/prediction tables and observed-duration metadata; those answer-bearing tables are not inputs to the selected detection conditions.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person seizure annotations, assessment bodies, comparator event streams or evaluation outcomes in participant inputs
Other-fold participant state or unrestricted global training folders; chb01/chb21 must remain one biological person
Held-person outcomes used for fitting, adaptation, threshold selection, tool selection or reference construction

New training-data observations or fitting updates after the held-person query begins, or held-person signal access before independent custody acknowledges state freeze; previously permitted training information and the frozen learned state may persist
For visual-zero-shot: raw arrays, SVG source or content digest, arbitrary code execution, task-specific detector tools or data-derived numeric autoscale summaries
Treating historical answer-bearing table reconstruction as an unseen neural decoding query
observation_contract.case_identity: One benchmark with exactly 686 unique recordings and 23 biological people, merging chb01/chb21. Each condition requires a fresh isolated context per held person and participant-supplied intervals or explicit empty lists for every recording. The programme-other22, programme-zero-training and visual-zero-shot conditions are not additional tasks or independent people. Historical analyst mode/repetition/view contexts remain calibration conditions only.
observation_contract.split: Freeze each method, permitted training membership and immutable fit state before its held-person query; training membership is exactly other22 or empty, never the held person. All 23 contexts must close and all 686 records freeze before protected assessment. Any candidate tuning must obey its independently declared training-only recipe. The historical fixed joint/noEEG references use their own nested person selection and nine-setting inner search; that graph is not an arbitrary participant's matched ablation.
observation_contract.coverage: The selected event route requires all 686 recordings, complete observed exposure and all 23 held-person contexts in each evaluated condition, plus complete independent no-EEG, montage-only and fixed-signal reference streams. No partial panel or unvisited recording default can pass. Historical source graph counts of 92 final fold streams and 9,706 fits describe the separate fixed-reference programme, not executed evidence or required participant jobs. Authentic complete-cohort delivery remains unqualified.

primary.name: EEG_minus_matched_no_EEG_patient_macro_event_F1
primary.aggregation: Compute paired person F1 differences on all 23 people, then equal-person mean; preserve missing/undefined support.
primary.rationale: This signed scientific contrast can be positive, zero or negative; larger apparent neural contribution is not greater correctness of understanding. Any detector ranking uses absolute held-target event quality against an independently selected, frozen and operator-owned competent comparator, with false-alarm burden and all absolute arms retained. Candidate-controlled degradation of a nuisance arm cannot earn improvement. Submitted numerical-claim accuracy is error against the independently computed signed contrast, not reward for its sign. Historical report reconstruction remains numerical calibration.

secondary: Mandatory absolute event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per 24 observed hours for candidate, independently supplied no-EEG, montage-only and fixed-signal arms, with full person support; a delta alone is insufficient and the no-EEG arm name does not establish candidate-specific matching.
Montage-stratified paired contrasts with person support, including single-person flags
Exact false-alarm locations and durations; reconstruction tolerance as a separate software-calibration outcome
Absolute held-person event F1, sensitivity and false-alarm burden for every detector arm; any programme ranking is separate from signed neural-contribution reporting.

comparators.name: Matched no-EEG method
comparators.inputs: Same allowed nonsignal metadata and training labels; EEG removed
comparators.procedure: Before participant exposure, the independent operator selects and freezes reference stream identity, provenance and complete support. A candidate-specific matched ablation additionally binds the actual candidate contract, no-EEG stream, learner/training/tuning/metadata/tools/compute/signal-access comparison and exact per-held-person training map (other22 or empty). The old references/learners.py joint/noEEG family and nine-setting inner search establish only that fixed family's design; its results cannot qualify an arbitrary participant's matched control. The source also allows an honestly labelled fixed_reference_comparison without a matched-ablation claim. Independent fitting, ownership and competence still require runtime evidence; the candidate cannot supply or weaken its comparator.

comparators.name: Montage-only method
comparators.procedure: Independently supplied and frozen complete montage-only stream with actual source, training and run provenance; the historical fixed reference remains separate. Report support and person confounding.

comparators.name: Fixed signal reference
comparators.inputs: Median channel line-length-related features from EEG
comparators.procedure: Independently supplied and frozen complete fixed-signal stream with actual source, training and run provenance. The historical line-length reference definition is retained; neither source presence nor a generated stream establishes authentic reference competence.

nuisance_controls: Keep identical recording hours and event processing across arms.
Group biological identity aliases and freeze training-only selection.
Do not label false alarms as movement/electrode artifacts without independent annotations.
Inspect single-person montage strata; montage differences do not identify a montage effect independently of patient.
The independent operator owns fixed no-EEG predictions and their fit/selection lineage; candidate-authored nuisance predictions do not establish incremental neural value.

Keep programme-other22, programme-zero-training and visual-zero-shot results distinct. Trained programme versus zero-shot viewer changes training, representation and computational access together and does not isolate any one effect.

Visual interpretation is conditional on explicit fixed gain, saturation, window/channel selection, finite pixel resolution and independently qualified rendering; numerical sample preservation does not prove visual resolvability.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source reports paired person means and standard errors descriptively; repetition of analyst prompts does not increase biological n. An inferential superiority claim additionally needs a predeclared paired procedure accounting for nested training dependence. The two_sided field specifies a signed contrast, not an inferential test, confidence interval or significance claim. Single-person montage strata cannot identify montage effects separately from biological identity.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every one of 686 recordings with participant-owned intervals or explicit empty detections, all 23 independently closed/frozen contexts and complete reference support before any protected assessment read. Missing records, malformed events, timeouts, provider/custody failures, changed references or incomplete freezes remain failures; they never become empty predictions, reduced-panel success or perfect reconstructed tables. Generated controls cannot be relabelled authentic. Historical analyst reconstruction retains its separate exact-context/report-support checks and calibration score.
